cards.d: If something is archaic, it is very old or outdated.
cards.e: To be competitive, we must update our archaic equipment.

cards.d: If someone is benevolent, they are kind and generous.
cards.e: My father was a benevolent man and gave lots of money to charity.

cards.d: Brass is a metal that is used to make musical instruments and ornaments.
cards.e: Brass is used to make musical instruments like trumpets.

cards.d: Capitalism is an economic system where private companies make goods for profit.
cards.e: Most industries in the world today are based on capitalism.

cards.d: A component is a part of a larger machine.
cards.e: Computers have many different components, so they are complicated to build.

cards.d: Dependence is a situation in which somebody relies on something else.
cards.e: Young children have a dependence on their parents.

cards.d: To diminish means to reduce or get smaller.
cards.e: As the economy got worse, my savings diminished.

cards.d: A drawback is a disadvantage.
cards.e: The drawback of having a car is that it is very expensive to maintain.

cards.d: A fad is something that is popular for a short time.
cards.e: The hula hoop was a fad for a few years, but it soon lost its popularity.

cards.d: To impose means to interrupt or force your ideas on other people.
cards.e: He imposes on his wife every morning by expecting her to make breakfast.

cards.d: Managerial describes something related to a manager or management.
cards.e: Nancy has a managerial position at the bank.

cards.d: If something is medieval, it comes from the period between 650 and 1500 CE.
cards.e: We visited a castle that was built during medieval times.

cards.d: If something is obsolete, it is not used anymore because something better exists.
cards.e: Since computers became inexpensive, typewriters have become obsolete.

cards.d: A peninsula is a large piece of land that is surrounded by the sea on three sides.
cards.e: The state of Florida is an example of a peninsula.

cards.d: If a person has prestige, people admire or respect them.
cards.e: The young actress gained much prestige after she won an award.

cards.d: A proportion is an amount that shows the link between the parts and the whole.
cards.e: Only a small proportion of the people in this town actually work here.

cards.d: If something is radical, it is very new or different.
cards.e: The president is planning to make some radical changes to the law.

cards.d: To refute something means to prove that it is false or incorrect.
cards.e: The bank manager has refuted the claims that he lied to his customers.

cards.d: If something is spectacular, it looks or sounds very impressive.
cards.e: There was a spectacular fireworks display in the park at New Year.

cards.d: To weave means to make cloth using horizontal and vertical threads.
cards.e: We saw a woman weave a blanket on our vacation to South America.
